items.title: Switch to semantic versioning (semver) from CalVer
items.subtitle: Semver adopted for improved dependency management semantics over CalVer
items.narrative: The project's versioning scheme was reconsidered and switched from CalVer (calendar-based versioning) to semantic versioning. Semver's structured format (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) enables package managers and downstream consumers to reason about compatibility more effectively. Breaking changes are explicitly signaled through MAJOR version increments, while MINOR and PATCH convey backward compatibility, making dependency resolution more predictable and reliable. This is particularly valuable for library and framework distributions where precise version constraints are critical for ecosystem stability.
